Name: (DGA)(CP-A) Animated Festive Winter Tree - Simple Foliage
Author: Shyziie
Description:
[center][color=#f4cccc][/color][color=#ead1dc][color=#ead1dc][color=#ead1dc][color=#ead1dc][color=#ead1dc][color=#ead1dc][color=#f4cccc]---------------[/color][color=#fce5cd]---------------[/color][color=#fff2cc]--------------[/color][color=#d9ead3]----------------[/color][/color][/color][/color][/color][/color][color=#c9daf8]--[/color][color=#ead1dc][color=#ead1dc][color=#ead1dc][color=#ead1dc][color=#ead1dc][color=#c9daf8]-------------[/color][color=#d9d2e9]---------------[/color][color=#ead1dc]---------------[/color][/color][/color][/color][/color][/color][/color][s]
[/s][s]
[/s]A remake of the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3929]Animated Festive Winter Tree[/url] mod by Paradigmnomad with a Simple Foliage retexture and various recolors.

On the 4 days before the Feast of the Winter Star festival, all pine trees will have animated holiday lights on them. Optionally, you can also have them on for the entire Winter using the config options. 🎄

[b]Now converted to [u]Dynamic Game Assets[/u] for optimization![/b]

[b][size=3][color=#f4cccc][size=3][b][color=#f4cccc]🌈[/color][/b][/size] R[/color][color=#fce5cd]e[/color][color=#fff2cc]c[/color][color=#d9ead3]o[/color][color=#d0e0e3]l[/color][color=#c9daf8]o[/color][color=#d9d2e9]r[/color] [color=#ead1dc]o[/color][color=#f4cccc]p[/color][color=#fce5cd]t[/color][color=#fff2cc]i[/color][color=#d9ead3]o[/color][color=#d0e0e3]ns[/color] [color=#d9d2e9]a[/color][color=#ead1dc]v[/color][color=#f4cccc]a[/color][color=#fce5cd]i[/color][color=#fff2cc]l[/color][color=#d9ead3]a[/color][color=#d0e0e3]b[/color][color=#c9daf8]l[/color][color=#d9d2e9]e[/color][color=#ead1dc]: [size=3]✨[/size][/color][/size][/b]

[b]Vanilla[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]StarBlue Valley[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14668]Nari's Naturally Valley[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2995]A Wittily Named Recolor
[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor
[/url]﻿[url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/580620-eemies-just-a-new-map-recolour-content-patcher-edition]Eemie's Just a New Map Recolour[/url][s][s]
[/s][/s]
Recolor options must be changed manually, either in the config.json file or by using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

You will need to sleep in game for changes to take effect if you use Generic Mod Config Menu while already loaded in your save.

If you decide to change your recolor option through the config.json, please see the Readme included in the mod or this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/1395]Article[/url] for config option names.[s][s]

[/s][/s]Please be advised that if you choose one of these recolours and do not have the recolour mod it is intended to match with downloaded and applied, that the stump and other little bits will not match with the rest of the tree.[s][s]

﻿3. Download the "[b](DGA) Animated Festive Winter Tree[/b]" mod and unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
